Archie Mobile · On Android now

Reach the agent on your computer from your phone.

Archie Mobile seals every message on your computer before it leaves. On Android you can install it today, and the iPhone app is with Apple for review.

Download Archie

Android installs from a file, so it stops you twice on the way: see the steps and why. Phone access needs a plan or a live trial. See where it stands →

The conversation

The app reaches your agent, which keeps running on your computer.

Your agent, files and connected accounts stay on your computer. The phone reaches it while that computer is awake and online.

Most of the desk

Chat, start agents and change add-ons from your phone.

Start or stop agents, manage add-ons and change routine times. The screens below show the controls.

What it cannot reach from your phone: your passwords and keys, your knowledge files, and the rows inside a collection. None of those is sent to the phone.

Sealed

Sealed before the message leaves your computer.

Your computer seals each message. A code you scan gives your phone the key.

The key never passes through us. We hold the sealed messages and cannot open them.

  • We still see when a message was left, which version of Archie wrote it, and whether it is waiting, done or failed, and never what it said.
  • Whoever holds the phone holds the key. Unpair it on the computer and that key retires.
  • Your chat app keeps working, and this is a second way in.

Side by side

Who can open what.

Each company’s own published words, and the Archie phone app on the last row.

Each chat app Archie connects to, what that company publishes about encryption, and whether that company can open your agent’s messages, compared with the app Otian is building.
  What that company publishes Can that company read it
Telegram An ordinary chat, the kind an agent uses, is stored “encrypted in the Telegram Cloud” and isn’t end to end. Telegram’s end-to-end Secret Chats are between two people, and an agent can’t use oneSource 1 Yes
Discord Every voice and video call is end-to-end encrypted. Text is not, in Discord’s own words: “We have no current plans to extend E2EE to text messages”Source 2 Yes
Slack “In Slack, customer data is encrypted at rest and in transit by default.” Archie joins as an ordinary bot, so your agent’s messages sit in that workspace like every other message in itSource 3 Yes
Matrix A Matrix room can be end-to-end encrypted. Archie cannot read one that is, so our connect guide asks for a room with encryption off. The same trade as the others, and it is our limitation rather than Matrix’sSource 4 Yes
iMessage on a Mac The exception. Apple encrypts it end to end and says “no one else can access your end-to-end encrypted data, not even Apple”. Archie reads it out of the Messages app on your own computer rather than over the networkSource 5 No
The Archie phone app Sealed on your computer before it leaves, under a key it gives your phone by camera. We hold the sealed messages and have no keySource 6 No, and neither can we
On your phone

Three things the app asks your phone for.

Permissions are asked for when you use each feature.

The camera

Scan the pairing code or take a photo for your agent. The camera is off otherwise.

Your photos

The app receives only the photo you choose; it cannot read the rest of your library.

The microphone

Record a voice note with the talk button. You can discard it, and recording stops if you leave the app.

A photo or a voice note goes to the computer running Archie, sealed, and we cannot read it.

Where Archie Mobile stands

On Android now from a file, and on iPhone after Apple’s review.

Android installs today from a file rather than Google Play, because a listing there needs a business identifier that takes weeks, and we need one first.

The iPhone app has been with Apple since September 17, 2026, and we cannot give you a date and will not invent one. Nothing about your setup has to change either way.

Sources for every claim on this page
1Telegram, on cloud chats and Secret Chats

“Secret chats use end-to-end encryption” while “Cloud Chats use client-server/server-client encryption and are stored encrypted in the Telegram Cloud”.

Also: “several court orders from different jurisdictions are required to force us to give up any data”. From the Telegram FAQ, read on September 11, 2026.

2Discord, on what its encryption covers

Discord’s DAVE protocol covers “every voice and video call on Discord, whether in DMs, group DMs, voice channels, or Go Live streams”.

On text: “We have no current plans to extend E2EE to text messages.” From Discord’s own announcement, read on September 11, 2026.

3Slack, on encryption

“In Slack, customer data is encrypted at rest and in transit by default.” From Slack’s security page, read on September 11, 2026.

4Matrix, and our own limitation

This row is about Archie’s connection. It can’t read an encrypted room, so the connect guide asks for one with encryption off. Matrix supports end-to-end encryption well, and the shortfall is ours.

5Apple, on iMessage

“No one else can access your end-to-end encrypted data, not even Apple.” From Apple’s iCloud data security overview, read on September 11, 2026.

One caveat Apple states on the same page: Messages in iCloud is end-to-end encrypted when iCloud Backup is off, so if you keep iCloud Backup on, check how Apple describes that before relying on it.

6Our side of the table

The sealed mailbox already carries phone access, and what we hold and cannot open is on the Trust page, line by line.

Messages are sealed with AES-256-GCM, an ordinary published cipher we did not invent, and the key travels in the part of a web address browsers never send to a server.

You can run both yourself: seal a message of your own and try to open it without the key.

What we have not claimed

This page doesn’t claim Telegram, Discord or Slack read your messages. It quotes what each publishes about what it can do, with links so you can check us.

It doesn’t call a chat app unsafe either: your agent works there today, and we built those connections on purpose. We described one mechanism and showed you where it fails.

You can reach your agent from your phone today, through a chat app.

Connecting one takes a few minutes and is the last step of setting an agent up. The Archie app is a second way in.
